name: Rent Collection Report
query:
select 
cl.name as 'Bill No:Link/Collection Log:180',
cl.serial as 'Serial:Link/Residence:180',
ser.area as 'Area:Data:180',
ser.tenant_name as 'Tenant Name:Data:180',
ser.phone_number as 'Phone Number:Data:180',
paid_on as 'Paid Date:Date:180',
month as 'Month:Data:100',
collected_by as 'Rent Collected By:Data:180',
case when is_rent = 'YES' then amount else 0 end as 'Collected Rent:Currency:180',
case when is_advance = 'YES' then cast(amount as decimal(10,2)) else 0 end as 'Collected Advance:Currency:180'
from `tabCollection Log` as cl
inner join `tabResidence` as ser on cl.serial = ser.name
where paid_on between %(from_date)s and %(to_date)s and cl.docstatus in (0, 1)
